query.commandtext: INSERT INTO ?? VALUES( :wafer_seq, :dieid, :x, :y, :cat, :qc )
SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT WHERE TESTAREA = :testarea AND PRODUCT = :product AND PROGRAM = :program AND LOT_ID = :lot_id
SELECT LOT_SEQ,WAFER_SEQ,PROBE_CNT FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id
UPDATE TQP_WAFER SET PROBE_CNT = PROBE_CNT+1 WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq

INSERT INTO TQP_WAFER(WAFER_SEQ,LOT_SEQ, WAFER_ID, TESTER, PROBE_CARD, OPERATOR, TESTED_DIE, START_TIME, END_TIME, LOSS_DIE) VALUES( WAFER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :lot_seq, :wafer_id, :tester, :probe_card, :operator,:tested_die, TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), sysdate, :loss_die )

INSERT INTO TQP_LOT(LOT_SEQ, PRODUCT, TESTAREA, PROGRAM, LOT_ID, MOTHER_LOT_ID, LOT_TYPE, FABLOT, FAMILY, FACILITY, DEVICE_ALIAS, START_TIME, END_TIME, WIP_STATUS, WAFERS) VALUES(LOT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :product, :testarea, :program, :lot_id, :mother_lot_id, :lot_type, :fablot, :family, :facility, :device_alias, TO_DATE(:start_time,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:end_time,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), :wip_status, :wafers)

SELECT USEMAP.X,USEMAP.Y ,DECODE(REALMAP.KILLER,NULL,0,'MACHINE',REALMAP.CAT,0) AS BIN ,DECODE(REALMAP.CAT,NULL,0,REALMAP.CAT) AS VI,USECODE FROM ( SELECT X, Y, A.CAT, A.QC AS KILLER FROM T_AVI_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.PROGRAM = :program AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND W.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ ) REALMAP, (SELECT X,Y,USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND U.USECODE >0 AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID) USEMAP WHERE USEMAP.X = REALMAP.X(+) AND USEMAP.Y = REALMAP.Y(+)

SELECT L.TESTAREA,PRODUCT,PROGRAM,LOT_ID,L.LOT_SEQ,FABLOT,WAFER_ID,W.WAFER_SEQ,W.START_TIME,W.END_TIME,W.OPERATOR FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W WHERE L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.END_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:stime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:etime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 ??
SELECT DISTINCT TESTAREA FROM TQP_LOT
UPDATE ?? SET QC = :qc WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND X = :x AND Y = :y

SELECT USEMAP.X,USEMAP.Y,DECODE(REALMAP.VIFAIL,NULL,0,REALMAP.VIFAIL) AS BIN,QC,USEMAP.USECODE FROM (SELECT X, Y, A.CAT AS VIFAIL,QC FROM T_AVI_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND W.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ) REALMAP, (SELECT X,Y,USECODE FROM TQP_LOT L, TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND U.USECODE >0 AND L.PRODUCT = P.PRODUCT AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID) USEMAP WHERE REALMAP.X(+) = USEMAP.X AND REALMAP.Y(+) = USEMAP.Y ORDER BY USEMAP.Y,USEMAP.X

SELECT USEMAP.X,USEMAP.Y,DECODE(REALMAP.VISUALINSP,NULL,0,REALMAP.VISUALINSP) AS VI ,DECODE( REALMAP.BIN ,NULL,0,REALMAP.BIN ) AS BIN,USEMAP.USECODE FROM (SELECT X, Y, BIN, VISUALINSP FROM TD_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.PROGRAM = :program AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND W.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ) REALMAP, (SELECT X,Y,USECODE FROM TQP_LOT L, TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.PROGRAM = :program AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND U.USECODE =1 AND L.PRODUCT = P.PRODUCT AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID) USEMAP WHERE REALMAP.X(+) = USEMAP.X AND REALMAP.Y(+) = USEMAP.Y ORDER BY USEMAP.Y,USEMAP.X
DELETE FROM T_AVI_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ=:wafer_seq AND QC=0 AND CAT=0
CALL PROC_RUN_AVI_SUMMARY(:product,:wafer_seq)
UPDATE TQP_WAFER_SUM SET PROBE_CNT = PROBE_CNT+1 WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq

SELECT A.WAFER_ID AS WID,NETDIE AS TOTAL ,ROUND( ((NETDIE - AVI_FAIL) / NETDIE) * 100,2) AS YIELD ,(NETDIE - AVI_FAIL) AS PASS ,AVI_FAIL AS FAIL,(TOT_FAIL - AVI_FAIL) AS KILL FROM ( SELECT L.PRODUCT,L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,L.LOT_SEQ,W.WAFER_SEQ,COUNT(*) AS TOT_FAIL FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W, T_AVI_LG A WHERE L.TESTAREA = 'AVI' AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND CAT > 0 AND PROBE_CNT = 0 AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ GROUP BY L.PRODUCT,L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,L.LOT_SEQ,W.WAFER_SEQ ) A, ( SELECT L.PRODUCT,L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,L.LOT_SEQ,W.WAFER_SEQ,COUNT(*) AS AVI_FAIL FROM TQP_LOT L,TQP_WAFER W, T_AVI_LG A WHERE L.TESTAREA = 'AVI' AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND KILLER = 'MACHINE' AND CAT > 0 AND PROBE_CNT = 0 AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ GROUP BY L.PRODUCT,L.LOT_ID,W.WAFER_ID,L.LOT_SEQ,W.WAFER_SEQ ) B, ( SELECT PRODUCT,NETDIE FROM TQP_MAPDEF M,TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND M.MAPID = P.MAPID ) C WHERE A.PRODUCT = B.PRODUCT AND A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.WAFER_ID = B.WAFER_ID AND A.PRODUCT = C.PRODUCT

-- Create Date : 2015-04-13 14:42:32 SELECT ROUND(USEMAP.XY / 65536) AS X, MOD(USEMAP.XY, 65536) AS Y, QC AS VI, CAT AS BIN, USEMAP.USECODE FROM (SELECT (X * 65536) + Y AS XY,QC,CAT FROM T_AVI_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND W.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ) REALMAP, (SELECT (X * 65536) + Y AS XY,USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID AND U.USECODE >0) USEMAP WHERE REALMAP.XY(+) = USEMAP.XY ORDER BY USEMAP.XY

-- Create Date : 2015-04-16 09:51:37 INSERT INTO TD_?? (SELECT :wafer_seq AS WAFER_SEQ, ROWNUM AS DIEID, X , Y , 0, 0, NULL FROM TQP_USEMAP WHERE MAPID = (SELECT MAPID FROM TQP_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT = :product) AND USECODE = 1 )

-- Create Date : 2015-04-21 17:02:21 SELECT DECODE(A.BIN,NULL,B.BIN,A.BIN) AS BIN ,DECODE(A.BIN_NAME,NULL,'BIN' || B.BIN,A.BIN_NAME) AS BIN_NAME,CNT ,NVL(COLOR, '#FFFFFF') AS COLOR FROM (SELECT * FROM TQP_VISUALINSPSPEC WHERE INSPTYPE = :testarea) A, (SELECT QC AS BIN,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM T_AVI_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq GROUP BY QC) B WHERE A.BIN(+) = B.BIN ORDER BY BIN

-- Create Date : 2015-04-21 17:06:42 SELECT DECODE(A.BIN,NULL,B.BIN,A.BIN) AS BIN ,DECODE(A.BIN_NAME,NULL,'BIN' || B.BIN,A.BIN_NAME) AS BIN_NAME,CNT ,NVL(COLOR, '#FFFFFF') AS COLOR FROM (SELECT * FROM TQP_VISUALINSPSPEC WHERE INSPTYPE = :testarea) A, (SELECT CAT AS BIN,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM T_AVI_?? WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq GROUP BY CAT) B WHERE A.BIN(+) = B.BIN ORDER BY BIN

-- Create Date : 2015-04-21 17:16:04 SELECT WAFER_SEQ,USEMAP.X,USEMAP.Y ,DECODE(REALMAP.KILLER,NULL,0,'MACHINE',REALMAP.BIN,0) AS BIN ,DECODE(REALMAP.BIN,NULL,0,REALMAP.BIN) AS VI,USECODE FROM ( SELECT A.WAFER_SEQ,X, Y, A.BIN, NULL AS KILLER FROM T_AVI_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE 1 = 1 AND L.DEVICE = :product AND W.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ ) REALMAP, (SELECT X,Y,USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND U.USECODE >0 AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID) USEMAP WHERE USEMAP.X = REALMAP.X(+) AND USEMAP.Y = REALMAP.Y(+)

-- Create Date : 2015-04-21 17:20:36 SELECT WAFER_SEQ,ROUND(USEMAP.XY / 65536) AS X, MOD(USEMAP.XY, 65536) AS Y, QC AS VI, CAT AS BIN, USEMAP.USECODE FROM (SELECT A.WAFER_SEQ,(X * 65536) + Y AS XY,QC,CAT FROM T_AVI_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TESTAREA = :testarea AND L.PRODUCT = :product AND W.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ) REALMAP, (SELECT (X * 65536) + Y AS XY,USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID AND U.USECODE >0) USEMAP WHERE REALMAP.XY(+) = USEMAP.XY ORDER BY USEMAP.XY

-- Create Date : 2015-04-13 14:42:32 SELECT ROUND(USEMAP.XY / 65536) AS X, MOD(USEMAP.XY, 65536) AS Y, 0 AS VI, BIN, NVL(USEMAP.USECODE, 0) AS USECODE FROM (SELECT (X * 65536) + Y AS XY,BIN FROM TD_?? A,TQP_WAFER W,TQP_LOT L WHERE L.TEST_AREA = :testarea AND L.DEVICE = :product AND L.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND W.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND L.LOT_SEQ = W.LOT_SEQ AND W.PROBE_CNT = 0 AND W.WAFER_SEQ = A.WAFER_SEQ) REALMAP, (SELECT (X * 65536) + Y AS XY,USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U, TQP_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT = :product AND P.MAPID = U.MAPID) USEMAP WHERE REALMAP.XY(+) = USEMAP.XY ORDER BY USEMAP.XY
